hebrewText: רֶ֤גַע יָמֻתוּ֮ וַ/חֲצ֪וֹת לָ֥יְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁ֣וּ עָ֣ם וְ/יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ/יָסִ֥ירוּ אַ֝בִּ֗יר לֹ֣א בְ/יָֽד

tokens.bdb: a wink (of the eyes), i.e. a very short space of time
to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, [idiom] crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy(-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro(-mancer), [idiom] must needs, slay, [idiom] surely, [idiom] very suddenly, [idiom] in (no) wise.

tokens.bdb: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
